desc: The Urban Pal should be standard equipment for survival in todays urban jungle. It is at home in a pocket or purse and can be easily attached to a key ring or hung around the neck. It is big enough to get the job done and its unique handle allows you to really put your weight into its point or edge. The simple teardrop shaped Kraton handle is small and thin. It gives extra traction to the fingers and protects the palm when the knife is used like a push knife or when using palm reinforced grip styles.
